content.summary: Reviewed B4 engineering implements four actual method adapters, frozen hidden references, equal source/call/byte/time ceilings and paired family reporting. Five focused tests passed. Empirical effectiveness is explicitly UNDER_BUDGETED: the controlled fixture requires 64 reserved calls and only 22 remain. No live dispatch or population ranking is authorized by acceptance.
findings: All eight scripted arm/case jobs execute real method code and Java scoring; initial reconstruction fixture used the wrong key and was repaired without changing the methods.
All-abstain and deliberately worse treatment controls preserve zero useful coverage or unsafe accepted results; missing pairs and source/budget drift veto the study.
Simultaneous bounded family intervals are derived in the design audit, with independent sampling and hidden-label assumptions explicit. One development family cannot support a ranking.
Provider receives public source content only; reference binding/scenario/outcome scoring happens after generation. Actual runtime and call consumption are retained.
B4 phase PASS means harness engineering acceptance only. Empirical and institution operational acceptance remain distinct unfinished criteria; continue B5.
